question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

One who has unlimited power
solution:
The correct answer is option 2) i.e. '**Omnipotent**.'

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let's look at the **meaning **of the marked option:

 
 
• Omnipotent- to have unlimited power and ability to do anything.
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *In the Ukraine-Russia war, Russia is acting like an **omnipotent **nation.*
 
 
 
• Let's look at the **meanings** of the other given options:
 
 
• **Omnivore- **an animal that is naturally able to eat both plants and meat.​
 
• **Omnipresent- **present or having an effect everywhere at the same time.
 
• **Omniscient- **having or seeming to have unlimited knowledge.
 
 
 
• Hence, from the given meanings, we find that ‘Omnipotent’ is the correct one-word substitute.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 2.

 

Correct one-word substitute:__ *Omnipotent.*
